title: Examples / Websites

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Keep partnership information within a partner-owned site so visitors can distinguish the site owner from supporting organizations.
strategic_value: Clear attribution and partner CTAs can let IBM support an offer without creating a misleading source identity.
demonstration: Two laptop frames show a group-partner landing page and an IBM-focused landing page, both led by the green partner logo.
practical_value: Choose grouped attribution or a dedicated partnership content section while keeping navigation and CTA ownership with the partner.

content_islands.name: Group landing page
content_islands.spec: Place the left laptop with partner masthead, an In partnership with logo row and partner call to action.

content_islands.name: Focus landing page
content_islands.spec: Place the right laptop with IBM acknowledgement and explanatory copy in the body, next to an image area and partner CTA.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples place IBM within page content as either one of several partners or a focused relationship section.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page labels both CTAs as the partner’s and states that its layout options are not exhaustive.
